lines.text: That's the fourth time I've died today.
Mind yourself, lad.
Same apple. Same words. Every time.
Three hours ago, I was in bed playing Roblox.
Server called Lanternfall. One player. Three AM.
I clicked join.
And the game... clicked back.
The first time round, I met her.
Oi! Stop that lantern!
Wren. Lamplighter's apprentice. Someone had stolen the Sun Lantern.
If it's not back by the last bell... the dark comes in.
The dark? Like... night?
No. The dark.
We followed the thief till sunset.
Then the last bell rang...
Mind yourself, lad.
So I tried again.
Second time, I kept her off the streets. The stairs gave way.
Third time, I hid us in a cellar. The lamp went out.
And every time I came back...
Sorry... have we met?
She didn't remember. Nobody did. Just me.
So the fourth time, I stopped playing nice.
Wren. Listen. I've died three times today. I keep coming back, and you keep—
Everything stopped. Except me.
Not. Yours. To tell.
I died before the sentence finished.
But that's not the part that scared me.
This time... the apple didn't stop at my feet.
Welcome back, Theo.
Nobody here knows my name.
Would you have told her... or kept quiet and kept dying?
And that... was only the fourth time I died today.
